title: Mars Tharsis-region shield volcano row
description: One Mars Tharsis-region shield volcano. Single row_type catalogue ('tharsis_volcano'); each row records published crater-count surface age + 1-σ uncertainty + summit position + summit elevation + edifice diameter + structural-role classification (tharsis_montes / olympus_outlier / alba_outlier).

name.description: Lower-case volcano name (arsia_mons / pavonis_mons / ascraeus_mons / olympus_mons / alba_mons).

age_myr.description: Crater-count surface age (youngest flows) in millions of years.

age_uncertainty_myr.description: 1-σ crater-count age uncertainty in millions of years.

latitude_deg.description: Summit latitude in Mars planetographic convention (north positive).

longitude_deg.description: Summit longitude in Mars planetographic convention (east positive, 0-360).

summit_elevation_m.description: Summit elevation above MOLA datum in metres.

edifice_diameter_km.description: Base diameter of the edifice in kilometres.

role.description: Structural role on the Tharsis bulge: 'tharsis_montes' for the three NE-SW ridge volcanoes (Arsia/Pavonis/Ascraeus); 'olympus_outlier' for the NW super-volcano; 'alba_outlier' for the older / broader Alba Mons north of the ridge.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — caldera geometry, mission context, age provenance.

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited Mars-volcano reference.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For mission/dataset release tags when applicable.
